memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Insomnia
  - Status: New onset, difficulty falling asleep, ISI score pending.
  - Plan: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS; counsel sleep hygiene.
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Seasonal sneezing, nasal congestion.
  - Plan: Cetirizine 10 mg HS, fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD, montelukast 10 mg HS.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Known, on levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD, seizure-free 6 months.
  - Plan: Continue current AEDs; check EEG, serum Na, creatinine.
Weight 58 kg, waist 82 cm (male cutoff 90 cm).
Diet advice: Breakfast – Indian roti with veg; Lunch – rice, dal, vegetables; Dinner – light khichdi.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been taking melatonin and trazodone at night. Sleep onset improved but I still wake up once. Nasal spray helps, but I feel drowsy in the morning.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow-up appointment booked for 2025-07-01 at 10:00 AM with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:

  - Status: Improved sleep latency, occasional nocturnal awakening.
  - Plan: Continue melatonin 3 mg HS; reduce trazodone to 25 mg HS to lessen morning drowsiness.
- Allergic rhinitis
  - Status: Symptoms controlled on current regimen.
  - Plan: Continue cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast; consider skin prick test to identify triggers.
- Epilepsy
  - Status: Seizure-free, medication tolerated.
  - Plan: Continue levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD; repeat electrolytes and creatinine.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Skin prick test performed: Wheal diameter 8 mm to dust mite allergen, histamine control 3 mm, saline negative. Indicates allergic sensitisation to house dust mite.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: ENT Specialist, Bangalore General Hospital
Reason: Persistent allergic rhinitis despite medical therapy, need for possible immunotherapy evaluation.
Clinical details: Positive skin prick to dust mite, symptomatic despite cetirizine, fluticasone, montelukast.
Request: Assessment for allergen-specific immunotherapy.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: From ENT: Patient evaluated, nasal endoscopy shows mild mucosal edema. Recommendation: Initiate subcutaneous immunotherapy (SCIT) for dust mite after confirming IgE levels. Continue current meds. Review in 3 months.
